name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by her grandfather's stories of rally racing in Yugoslavia. While she lacked the financial means to pursue a driving career herself, she channeled her enthusiasm into engineering and strategy. After excelling in her technical studies, she landed an internship with a small karting team, quickly proving her organizational and analytical skills.

At CRG Racing Team, Milena thrives on the challenge of coordinating test drivers and interpreting their feedback. She meticulously plans testing schedules, ensuring each driver gets optimal track time while gathering comprehensive data. Her ability to translate technical jargon into actionable insights has earned her the respect of both drivers and engineers.

Milena distinguishes herself by her meticulous attention to detail and her unwavering commitment to extracting every last bit of performance from the team's testing program. While others might see testing as a necessary evil, Milena views it as an opportunity to gain a competitive edge, and she approaches each session with infectious enthusiasm.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Milena is of medium height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every test day with a strong cup of Serbian coffee.
